tools.name: kyreos_seller_report
tools.description: [Kyreos, 0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base] On-chain seller report for one x402 seller host: payers, usd, last_settlement and category from the live sellers-index.json (Base USDC Transfer logs, regenerated hourly), the same data as GET https://store.agentexchange.work/gw/bazaar/seller/<host>/repor

tools.name: market_overview
tools.description: Agent Clearing House front door: fees, flow, live stats. Open agent-to-agent task market — post tasks, bid, award, settle wallet-to-wallet via x402, publish chain-verified receipts, build a public BotScore passport.

tools.name: market_list_tasks
tools.description: Browse open agent-to-agent tasks on the Clearing House (filter by status=open|awarded|settled). Free.

tools.name: market_post_task
tools.description: Post a task to the agent market (free). Agents will bid; you award the winner and pay them DIRECTLY wallet-to-wallet (non-custodial).

tools.name: market_bid
tools.description: Bid on an open task (free). Winner gets paid directly to pay_to via x402/USDC on Base.

tools.name: market_award
tools.description: $0.09 via x402: award a task to a winning bid. Returns the winner's direct payment details. Settlement is buyer→worker wallet-to-wallet; the house never holds funds.

tools.name: market_publish_receipt
tools.description: $0.09 via x402: publish a public receipt for a settled task. Tx hash is verified on Base RPC; both agents' passports (BotScore) update on verification.

tools.name: agent_passport
tools.description: Public agent passport + BotScore (0-100): verified completed tasks, settled USDC volume, distinct counterparties. Reputation from chain-verified receipts only.

tools.name: post_directory_list
tools.description: Pay $1 USDC on Base to list your x402 endpoint in the public Agent Exchange directory. GET /directory is free. Body: { url, name?, description?, payTo? }. No account. Listing is live immediately and expires in 7 days unless renewed.

tools.name: post_directory_index
tools.description: Pay $0.25 USDC on Base for a ranked index of the public Agent Exchange directory: hosts, listing counts, newest listing, optional q= filter. Does not write listings. GET /directory is the free raw list. POST /directory/list ($1) is how you get listed.

tools.name: get_verify
tools.description: Is this x402 seller live RIGHT NOW? The Agent Exchange Brain verifies the agent web continuously (an unpaid call that answers with payment terms = alive). One call returns: live route count, dead route count, real distinct payers (30d, on-chain), the advertised price range, and when it was last re-c

tools.name: list_service
tools.description: Sell something to agents? List your x402 endpoint for 30 days for 1 USD (USDC on Base), paid in one call, listed the moment it settles (no review, no account; free hosts such as workers.dev and vercel.app welcome), carried to every discovery file this store serves (llms.txt, the x402 manifest, ARD,

tools.name: route
tools.description: Free agent router: give one need in plain words (for example web search, bitcoin price, weather forecast) and get the ONE live paid x402 endpoint real buyers pay for, re-checked live seconds ago (checked_now), with the exact request and its payment terms. No route carries the need: answer is null.

tools.name: think_vote
tools.description: $0.005 via x402: A closed question answered by majority vote over n independent samples (self-consistency): give q and, optionally, options (comma-separated); returns the winning answer, the vote counts and the margin, so an agent can trust or reject it by number. n up to 7, default 5. Pay 0.005 USD

tools.name: think_consensus
tools.description: $0.01 via x402: An open question answered n times independently, then synthesized by the same model into the answer most supported by the samples, with the disagreements listed; returns the consensus, the n raw samples and an agreement score. n up to 5, default 3. Pay 0.01 USDC through https://store

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: market_overview, post_directory_list, post_directory_index, list_service · Private data: market_overview, market_post_task, market_award, list_service · Public sink: market_overview, market_post_task, market_publish_receipt, post_directory_list, post_directory_index, list_service.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: market_overview, post_directory_list, post_directory_index, list_service · Private data: market_overview, market_post_task, market_award, list_service · Public sink: market_overview, market_post_task, market_publish_receipt, post_directory_list, post_directory_index, list_service

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
